links.note: asks whose fables the poem is adapted from -- Aesop
asks how the poet describes the cricket: silly, young, accustomed to sing, all of the above
asks when the cricket began to complain -- when his cupboard was empty and winter had come
vocabulary item, closest meaning to 'scarcity of food' -- famine, per the poem's own glossary
asks what he wanted from the ant -- shelter from rain and a mouthful of grain
asks whether he wished to repay the ant -- yes, tomorrow, part of the same plea
asks what he would die of if refused -- starvation and sorrow, the poem's own phrase
asks who said 'I am your servant and friend' -- the ant, opening his reply
asks the ants' policy -- never borrow, never lend, stated in the same reply
asks what the ant advised him to do all winter -- dance the winter away
